message:
The open press returns for a weekend of two-color prints

Visiting makers share the blocks and color separations behind a new edition.

The first run pairs a blue block with a rust-colored overlay. Visitors can handle the proofs and try aligning a second color on the studio press.

#culture

Inside the paper lab making books from offcuts

Bookbinders turn yesterday’s paper scraps into tomorrow’s sketchbooks.

At the long table, each offcut is sorted by grain direction before the sheets are folded into signatures. The first finished books join the workshop lending shelf.

#economy

Six new patterns from the weaving room

The weaving studio shares its first sampler.

Visitors can compare six weave structures made with the same pair of yarns.

#politics

A pocket guide to setting movable type

The type room has issued a new reference card.

It covers spacing, alignment and putting a case back in order after printing.

#technology

First proofs arrive for the winter exhibition

The gallery has received the first signed sheets.

A selection will hang beside the blocks used to print them.

#culture

An evening of book repair at the long table

A drop-in session opens this week.

Bring a worn paperback to learn how to mend a hinge.

#sport

How a small loom travels between studios

The portable loom makes its first stop.

Two collectives will share the equipment through the coming month.

#world

Found-paper collage takes over the workshop wall

A new display opens in the cutting room.

Collective members assembled the panels from discarded proof sheets.

#gossip

A second press opens for early sessions

A proof press is ready for weekday bookings.

The first hour each morning is reserved for short test runs.

#technology

Friday binding circle adds a drop-in table

The weekly binding circle has room for four more makers.

Paper and linen thread will be supplied at the door.

#society

Open shelves welcome a new print exchange

The studio library has opened its print exchange to visiting artists.

Leave one small edition and take a print from the community shelf.

#news

Studio library extends evening hours

The library will stay open through the evening on Thursday.

The reference collection and reading tables will be available until closing.

#society

Two new worktables join the paper room

The new cutting benches are ready to use.

Each bench has a shared ruler and a fresh cutting mat.

#economy

Weekend sketch walk starts at the courtyard

The sketch group meets at the courtyard entrance.

Participants can borrow a clipboard at the tool counter.

#sport

The tool counter adds a second hand press

The counter now lends two portable presses.

Both presses come with a starter set of soft blocks.

#technology
